_note: Interactive cost scenario. List prices, per user per month, billed annually, as of Nov 2026. No discounts, partner services or third-party apps. Show the assumptions and disclaimer beside the results at all times.

includeDataHub.label: Two-way warehouse sync (HubSpot needs Data Hub Enterprise)

includeSfApiAddon.label: Salesforce Web Services API add-on (+$25/user/month on Pro Suite)

options.label: HubSpot Professional (Sales + Service)
options.note: Custom objects, sandbox and field-level permissions are NOT included at this tier.

options.label: Salesforce Core
options.note: Includes 500K Flex Credits per org. Don't state an allotment period.

formula: annual = (salesSeats + serviceSeats) * seatPrice * 12 + addonMonthly * 12 + addonPerSeatMonthly * seats * 12;  total = annual * years + onboardingPerHub * hubs (one-time, HubSpot only)

referenceCheck._note: Unit-test fixture. With 30 sales + 20 service seats, these must match exactly.

presentationRules: Headline the TIER JUMP: the capabilities a growing CBS company needs are Enterprise-only at HubSpot ($90 → $150, +67%, plus onboarding per hub). Salesforce Pro Suite includes custom objects and a sandbox at $100.
Never claim Salesforce is cheaper overall. Core is not cheaper seat-for-seat at list. Position it as more capability per dollar and fewer add-ons.
Never compare AI cost per resolution. If AI is discussed, compare predictability: credits that last the contract vs monthly reset and pause.
Always show: 'List prices, per user per month, billed annually, as of Nov 2026. Excludes discounts, partner services and third-party apps. Validate scope with your Salesforce account executive.'
